kpis.description_en: Henkel reports organic sales growth of 2.6% in 2024, driven by its Adhesive Technologies and Consumer Brands segments.
kpis.explanation_en: Sales evolution excluding foreign exchange and scope effects, to measure underlying performance.

kpis.description_en: The adjusted EBIT margin reaches 14.3% in 2024, up 2.4 percentage points, supported by efficiency gains and improved cost management.
kpis.explanation_en: Operating margin adjusted for non-recurring items, a key profitability indicator.

kpis.signal_en: Stabilization of sales after two years of decline.
kpis.description_en: Sales amount to EUR 21.586 billion in 2024, a slight increase compared to 2023.
kpis.explanation_en: Total revenue generated by the company during the year.

kpis.signal_en: Strong rebound in adjusted operating profit.
kpis.description_en: Adjusted operating profit reaches EUR 3.089 billion, up 20.9%, supported by productivity gains.
kpis.explanation_en: Operating profit adjusted for exceptional charges.

kpis.signal_en: Solid growth in adjusted earnings per share.
kpis.description_en: Adjusted earnings per share amount to EUR 5.36 in 2024, up 23.2%, reflecting improved profitability.
kpis.explanation_en: Portion of adjusted net profit attributable to each share.

kpis.signal_en: Dividend increase for the first time in several years.
kpis.description_en: The proposed dividend per preferred share is EUR 2.04, up 10.3%, marking a return to dividend growth.
kpis.explanation_en: Amount paid to preferred shareholders per share held.

kpis.signal_en: Dividend per share of EUR 2.05 in the latest year.
kpis.description_en: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.

kpis.signal_en: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of EUR 0.85 billion in the latest year.
kpis.description_en: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 fiscal years reported.

kpis.signal_en: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 41.8% in the latest year.
kpis.description_en: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.

hero_kpi_rationale_en: The Adhesive Technologies segment represents 51% of Henkel's total sales and is the primary driver of group growth and profitability, with an adjusted EBIT margin of 16.6% and organic growth of 2.4%.

ai_positioning.summary_en: Henkel does not mention any significant artificial intelligence strategy or initiative in its 2024 annual report. The company does not position AI as a strategic lever.
evidence_en: No mention of AI or machine learning in strategic sections.
No references to AI tools in industrial or commercial processes.
Absence of AI-related KPIs or projects in financial or operational reporting.

risks.title: Intense competitive pressure on consumer brands
risks.score_rationale_en: The Consumer Brands segment reports organic decline of -1.6% in H1 2025 and -6.8% nominally, with a downward revision of the outlook (0.5-1.5% vs 1.0-3.0% previously). The revised outlook language indicates structural competitive pressure on consumer brands from private labels and local players.

risks.title: Rising costs of direct raw materials
risks.score_rationale_en: The 2025 outlook explicitly mentions an increase in direct raw material prices in the 'low to mid-single-digit percentage' range compared to the prior year average. This cost item represents ~49% of sales (cost of goods sold), making it a critical margin lever for both segments.

risks.title: Geopolitical exposure and depreciation of emerging market currencies
risks.score_rationale_en: The outlook signals a negative foreign exchange impact in the 'low to mid-single-digit' range on nominal sales, worse than initial forecasts. Latin America reports -13.2% nominally (-34.6% on adjusted EBIT) in H1 2025, and IAS 29 adjustments (hyperinflation) generate EUR 1.572 billion in translation losses in OCI.

risks.title: Risk of prolonged restructuring and organizational transformation
risks.score_rationale_en: 2025 restructuring charges are estimated at EUR 150-200 million (revised downward from EUR 200-250 million), with EUR 46 million already recorded in H1. The merger of Beauty Care and Laundry & Home Care into 'Consumer Brands' generates recurring integration costs and operational execution risks.

risks.title: Dependence on North American markets and sectoral slowdown
risks.score_rationale_en: North America represents 27% of Group sales and reports -7.0% nominally (-3.4% organically) in H1 2025, with accelerating deterioration in Q2 (-10.4% nominally). This market is critical for Adhesive Technologies (automotive, electronics), sectors exposed to industrial cycles and U.S. tariffs.

risks.title: Risk of integration and valuation of recent acquisitions
risks.score_rationale_en: Goodwill represents 42.2% of total assets (EUR 13.846 billion as of 06/30/2025), down EUR 1.19 billion over 12 months, partly due to currency effects. Purchase price adjustments (Composite Technology, Seal for Life) were required, indicating integration complexities. Impairments remain limited (EUR 4 million), but goodwill impairment risk remains high.

risks.title: Regulatory risk on chemicals and sustainability
risks.score_rationale_en: Henkel operates in specialty chemicals (adhesives, detergents, cosmetics), sectors subject to REACH in Europe, EPA regulations in the U.S., and increasing ESG standards. Although not detailed in this semi-annual report, this category is structurally important for a chemical group of this size with 16% margin ambitions.

risks.title: Erosion of competitive position in Asia-Pacific amid local competition
risks.score_rationale_en: Asia-Pacific reports positive organic growth (+3.4%) but has the highest adjusted margin (20%), attracting aggressive local competition, particularly in China. The region represents 16% of sales and is a strategic growth pillar; defending it is critical to achieving medium-term ambitions of 3-4% organic growth.

tagline: Pioneers at heart for the good of generations
